families.overview: GE Spectra Series group-mounted switchboards (Plainville CT) use Spectra plug-in distribution panel interiors in which branch breakers mount on AMC plug-in modules; fusible branch units can be field-substituted with circuit breaker units. Pro-Stock program numbers SWPS<amps><M|L|D><C|A><T|B>N1[EPM] (DEA-623).
